title: The reality is that
titleZh: 「The reality is that ...」陳述實際情況
titleEn: Using The reality is that to state the actual situation

source.file: Sentence Structure 182 - The reality is that 陳述實際情況.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: The reality is that + subject + verb + other information

formulas.formula: The reality is that + subject + verb + other information
Expectation / appearance + but + the reality is that + complete clause

example: The reality is that sustainable progress takes time.
exampleZh: 現實是，可持續的進步需要時間。

examples.en: The reality is that sustainable progress takes time.
examples.zh: 現實是，可持續的進步需要時間。
examples.highlight: The reality is that sustainable progress takes time.

rules.zh: that 後面必須接一個完整子句；該子句要有自己的主語和動詞。
rules.en: Write a complete clause after that. The clause needs its own subject and verb.

rules.zh: reality 是單數，所以要用 is，不要用 are。
rules.en: Use is, not are, because reality is singular.

rules.zh: 這個句型用來陳述實際情況，尤其適合說明現實與人們的想法、希望、期望、說法或第一印象不同。
rules.en: Use this structure to state the actual situation, especially when it differs from what people think, hope, expect, claim or see at first.

rules.zh: 保留原句的時態、否定意思，以及 may、can、should、must 等情態動詞所表達的程度。
rules.en: Keep the original tense, negative meaning and modal words such as may, can, should and must.

rules.zh: 本練習每個答案都必須包含完整的 the reality is that。這個句型可以放在句首，也可以放在簡短背景之後。
rules.en: Every answer in this exercise must include the exact words the reality is that. The phrase may appear at the beginning or after a short context.

benefits.zh: 這個句型會清楚告訴讀者或聽者：「以下才是實際情況。」
benefits.en: It makes the actual situation clear by signalling to the reader or listener, “What follows is the reality.”
examples: It makes the actual situation clear.

benefits.zh: 你不必直接說「你錯了」，也可以有禮貌地指出想法與事實之間的分別。
benefits.en: It helps you correct a mistaken idea politely by distinguishing an assumption from the facts without directly saying, “You are wrong.”
examples: It helps you correct a mistaken idea politely.

benefits.zh: the reality is that 會把注意力帶到後面的事實，適合用於說話、作文、報告和簡報。
benefits.en: It draws attention to your main point: the reality is that directs attention to the fact that follows, making it useful in speaking, essays, reports and presentations.
examples: It draws attention to your main point.

benefits.zh: 它可以把「人們以為怎樣」和「實際上怎樣」連接成一句清楚的句子。
benefits.en: It connects an expectation and the actual fact in one clear sentence.
examples: It connects an expectation and the actual fact in one clear sentence.

benefits.zh: 這個固定句框能幫助你在說話時更快組織答案，也能避免重複使用 actually、in fact 或簡單的 but 句。 Sentence Structure Transformation | 句型改寫練習 （人們可能期望立即見到成果，但可持續的進步需要時間。） （人們可能期望立即見到成果，但現實是，可持續的進步需要時間。）
benefits.en: It gives you a ready-made speaking frame that helps you organise an answer quickly and avoids repeatedly using actually, in fact or simple but-sentences. Compare People may expect instant results, but sustainable progress takes time with People may expect instant results, but the reality is that sustainable progress takes time.
examples: It gives you a ready-made speaking frame and another way to organise a sentence.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.
